notes.title: DEMO UPDATE 1.2
notes.notes:
The demo has been updated (1.2)

[list]
[*] Added tutorials for crouching and jumping shots.
[*] Fixed the tutorial stage being too big.
[*] Add more set dresses to the tutorial stage to increase the level of details.
[*] Increase the level of detail in the tutorial background cube.
[*] Fixed infinite bullets.
[*] Added mouse sensitivity adjustment.
[*] Added sound volume adjustment.
[*] Added supports switching to windowed mode.
[*] Turned off colliders from enemy corpses
[*] Fixed an error where a Super Attack would not activate if performed immediately after a Baton Attack.
[*] Added a language selection screen when first starting the app.
[*] Added a screen to select how to play when the game is started for the first time.
[*] Fixed an error that caused a momentary drop in frames when each effect first appeared.
[*] Added tutorial for mouse and keyboard.
[*] Added color accents to aid gameplay (red)
[*] The door focus animation has been shortened a little.
[*] The boss appearance animation has been shortened a little.
[*] Added CRT effect to Sekiguchi-san.
[*] Added invert Y settings.
[/list]

*There was a glitch with the SURVIVAL camera, which has now been fixed.(2024.12.24)
